subtasks.name: Backend password reset, email change, session revocation, 2FA, and OAuth provider discovery
Auth security tests for no-enumeration, expiring/reused tokens, sessions, and 2FA recovery codes

notes: Implemented account recovery and login security: password reset without account enumeration, one-time expiring reset/email-change tokens, server-backed session IDs with revocation, TOTP 2FA with one-time recovery codes, OAuth provider discovery, forgot-password and 2FA login UI, and a /security settings page. Checks passed: API ruff, full API pytest (26 passed), clean SQLite Alembic upgrade through 0010, web typecheck/lint/build, docker compose config, git diff --check (CRLF warnings only), and browser preview DOM check for /security.
